macros.name: Arg
macros.doc: \Arg{argument} Argument: \Arg{filename} will be typeset as filename.

macros.name: Bar
macros.doc: \Bar is typeset as |.

macros.name: Bs
macros.doc: \Bs (BackSlash) is typeset as \.

macros.name: Circum
macros.doc: \Circum is typeset as ˆ. \Percent is typeset as %.

macros.name: Cmd
macros.doc: \Cmd{command}{chapter} used to typeset references to other commands, e.g. \Cmd{latex2man}{1} will be typeset as latex2man(1).

macros.name: Date
macros.doc: \Date returns the date information.

macros.name: Dots
macros.doc: \Dots is typeset as ...

macros.name: Email
macros.doc: \Email{..} use to mark an Email address: \Email{Juergen.Vollmer@informatik-vollmer.de} is typeset as: Juergen.Vollmer@informatik-vollmer.de.

macros.name: File
macros.doc: \File{filename} used to typeset filenames, e.g. \File{filename} will be typeset as filename.

macros.name: HTMLbr
macros.doc: \HTMLbr If HTML output is generated, causes a linebreak (i.e. is equivalent to \\), otherwise ignored.

macros.name: LatexManEnd
macros.doc: \LatexManEnd the input file is read and processed until reading end-of-file or \LatexManEnd (at the beginning of a line).

macros.name: LBr
macros.doc: \LBr, \RBr is typeset as { and } (these variants are needed when using { or } as arguments to macros.

macros.name: MANbr
macros.doc: \MANbr If Man-Page output is generated, causes a linebreak (i.e. is equivalent to \\), otherwise ignored.

macros.name: oArg
macros.doc: \oArg{argument} Optional argument, e.g. \oArg{filename} will be typeset as [filename].

macros.name: oOpt
macros.doc: \oOpt{option} Optional option, e.g. \oOpt{-o} will be typeset as [-o].

macros.name: oOptArg
macros.doc: \oOptArg{option}{argument} Optional option with argument, e.g. \oOptArg{-o}{filename} will be typeset as [-ofilename].

macros.name: oOptoArg
macros.doc: \oOptoArg{option}{argument} Optional option with optional argument, e.g. \oOptoArg{-o}{filename} will be typeset as [-o[filename]].

macros.name: Opt
macros.doc: \Opt{option} Option: \Opt{-o} will be typeset as -o.

macros.name: OptArg
macros.doc: \OptArg{option}{argument} Option with Argument: \OptArg{-o}{filename} will be typeset as -ofilename.

macros.name: OptoArg
macros.doc: \OptoArg{option}{argument} Option with optional Argument: \OptoArg{-o}{filename} will be typeset as -o[filename].

macros.name: Percent
macros.doc: \Circum is typeset as ˆ. \Percent is typeset as %.

macros.name: Prog
macros.doc: \Prog{prog} used to typeset program names, e.g. \Prog{latex2man} will be typeset as latex2man.

macros.name: Rbr
macros.doc: \Lbr, \Rbr is typeset as [ and ] (these variants are needed only somtimes like in \item[FooBar\LBr xx \Lbr].

macros.name: setDate
macros.doc: \setDate{..} sets .. as date information.

macros.name: setVersion
macros.doc: \setVersion{..} set .. as version information.

macros.name: setVersionWord
macros.doc: \setVersionWord{..} set .. for the word Version: in the footline.

macros.name: SP
macros.doc: \SP Produces some extra space, works also at the beginning of lines.

macros.name: TEXbr
macros.doc: \TEXbr If processed with LaTeX causes a linebreak (i.e. is equivalent to \\).

macros.name: TEXIbr
macros.doc: \TEXIbr If TexInfo output is generated, causes a linebreak (i.e. is equivalent to \\), otherwise ignored.

macros.name: Tilde
macros.doc: \Tilde is typeset as a ∼.

macros.name: URL
macros.doc: \URL{..} use to mark an URL: \URL{http://www.foo.de/\Tilde vollmer} is typeset as http://www.foo.de/∼vollmer.

macros.name: Version
macros.doc: \Version returns the version information.

envs.name: Description
envs.doc: \begin{Description} is the same as \begin{description} \begin{Description}[label] is similar to \begin{description}, but the item labels have at minimum the size of the (optional) word label.

envs.name: Table
envs.doc: The Table environment takes two arguments: the first optional one specifies a width of the last column, the second one gives the number of columns.
